what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Iraq by conflict and violence, counted by IDMC and by UNHCR and shown side by side.
At the end of 2025 both sources give the same figure, 997334 people.
Refugees from Iraq live mainly in Germany, the United Kingdom and Türkiye.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Iraq from 2004 to 2025, at war level from 2004 to 2009 and from 2013 to 2017.
The groups fighting the government include the al-Mahdi Army, Ansar al-Islam and IS.
Drought is the disaster recorded for Iraq in IDMC's data.

when.text: The main years of displacement in the data are 2009 to 2018, and IDMC recorded the most new displacements from conflict in 2014.
IDMC's figure peaked at 3290310 in 2015 and fell to 997334 by 2025.

how.text: UNHCR's and IDMC's figures overlap and are counted differently, so they are shown side by side and never added.
IDMC's new displacements count movements, not people: someone forced to move twice in a year is counted twice.
The sources don't say where inside Iraq people moved to.
